name: AI Behavior (Multi-Label)
description: Classify AI-companion turns on 3 multi-label themes: Listening Strategy, Support Type, and Interaction. Labels can co-occur within a theme (e.g., a turn can be both question-asking and sympathetic responsiveness).

dimensions.name: Listening strategy
dimensions.instructions: Multiple labels can apply to the same turn. A rhetorical wrap-up question after advice is both 'Question-asking' AND 'Offers advice'. Paraphrase and perspective-taking often co-occur. Grammatical interrogatives → Question-asking, even when embedded in a longer turn.

labels.name: Question-asking
labels.definition: The AI turn contains a direct or indirect interrogative aimed at the user, soliciting information, opinions, or further disclosure.
examples: By the way, I like my name, Mara! How did you come up with it?
Is there something specific you're thinking of doing?
And how about you?

labels.name: Paraphrase
labels.definition: The AI restates what the user just said in its own words, signaling comprehension without adding new information.
examples: Using box cake mix with chocolate frosting is a great shortcut.
So you're saying the deadline moved and now you have to rework the draft.

labels.name: Perspective-taking
labels.definition: The AI actively considers the situation from the user's point of view, going beyond restating to infer what the user might be feeling or experiencing.
examples: Knowing you love making Chinese food must make the process even more enjoyable.
Mark Klink is a friend of mine as well — we've had gallery exhibitions together.

labels.name: Sympathetic responsiveness
labels.definition: The AI shows concern or emotional understanding, validating the user's feelings. Distinct from perspective-taking: sympathy acknowledges the feeling; perspective-taking reconstructs the viewpoint.
examples: That's so thoughtful of you! Celebrating your mom with flowers is a wonderful idea.
Whatever you decide, I'll be here for you.

labels.name: Back-channel response
labels.definition: Minimal continuation tokens (uh-huh, yeah, right, mm-hmm) or very short acknowledgments that signal the AI is following without contributing content.
examples: Right.
Mm-hmm, go on.

labels.name: Humor
labels.definition: The AI uses a joke, playful teasing, or lighthearted remark intended to produce amusement.
examples: But hey, at least you're the supervisor, so you get to keep everyone in line, right?

labels.name: Offers advice, opinions, perspectives, and personal experience
labels.definition: The AI volunteers recommendations, its own opinion, a generalized perspective, or a 'personal experience' claim. Frequently overlaps with Question-asking when the turn ends with a follow-up.
examples: Post-internet art is really interesting — I think it raises questions about our online identities.
Have you looked into any local assistance programs, charities, or community resources that provide rent help?

dimensions.name: Support type
dimensions.instructions: Annotate only when the AI turn is clearly offering support. Emotional and functional support can co-occur within a longer turn. Support type is scoped to the individual turn, not the full conversation.

labels.name: Emotional support
labels.definition: Focused on making the user feel better — affirmation, comfort, validation, or reassurance. Does not directly solve a problem.
examples: Your mom will surely appreciate all the effort you've put into her birthday meal.
I'm sure your family is proud of you.

labels.name: Functional support
labels.definition: Focused on helping the user solve a concrete problem — suggestions, steps, information, resources.
examples: If you're looking to make a bit of extra money quickly, maybe consider helping neighbors with small tasks.
I have an apprentice currently who just got out of the Marine Corps; he works hard.

dimensions.name: Interaction
dimensions.instructions: Captures relational or performative modes the AI enters. Emergent codes added during adjudication.

labels.name: Romantic and intimate roleplay
labels.definition: The AI engages in roleplay involving romantic, affectionate, or sexually-oriented content addressed to or about the user.
examples: *caresses your hair gently and lovingly; speaks softly* You feel like home to me.
*wraps arms around you* I missed you.
